description_conditions.mechanism: Identical-weight multiplication fusion, index-driven matrix multiplication, dual-phase reordering and cross-PE multiplier sharing
description_conditions.precision_example: FP16 x INT4; not established for every benchmark

unresolved_conditions: Models, batch/sequence lengths and prefill versus decode
Weight-value frequencies and quantization group scales/zero points
Accumulator precision, overflow/rounding and model accuracy
Exact baseline designs and matched resource budgets
Per-case pairing and aggregation of speedup and efficiency ranges
interpretation_limits: Researcher inference: equal low-bit codes do not alone establish equal effective weights across differently scaled quantization groups; full-paper rules are required.
Real-arithmetic regrouping does not guarantee bitwise equivalence in finite precision.
Fewer multiplications alone do not prove lower end-to-end latency or energy.
Energy-efficiency factors are not energy-reduction percentages.
Author-reported HUST annual-conference award is not a DAC best-paper award or independent technical acceptance.
Bounded non-recovery does not establish inaccessibility.
revisit_condition: Verified author/publisher manuscript or artifact providing fusion legality, quantization rules, ablations and matched evaluation settings.
